drop: Drop an MHTML or MHT file here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable MHTML or MHT archive with document content.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This archive has missing resources or content that cannot fit the supported print layout. Try a complete capture of the main document with simpler styles and included images.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: The archived main document is reflowed onto A4 portrait pages with 18 mm margins and rendered as image pages at 150 DPI. Basic formatting, lists, tables, code and supported archived images are included.
limitations: Text in the PDF is not selectable; OCR and interactive links are not added. Scripts, forms, embedded apps, SVG and MathML are omitted. Missing image/style resources prevent conversion. Complex web layouts and embedded fonts are not supported.
layoutNotice: This is a static print copy of the archived main document. Fonts, spacing and pagination may differ from the saved page. Wide tables and code are reflowed. Check every page before downloading.
encoding: This archive declares a text encoding that this browser does not support. Save a complete UTF-8 capture and try again.
incomplete: This archive is incomplete. Save a complete MHTML copy and try again.
nested: This archive contains embedded frames or additional pages. Save the main document on its own before converting.
structure: Choose an MHTML or MHT web archive. Plain HTML and other multipart files need their corresponding tools.
email: This file is an email message. Use the Email Viewer to read it.
